amphan-2020.name: Amphan
amphan-2020.synopticAssessment: Post-event verification proved that the 5 km conditional diffusion model accurately localized the severe rainfall corridor along the Hooghly estuary 36 hours before peak inundation, whereas standard 12 km NWP diluted the peak over open water.

heatwave-2022.name: North India Heatwave
heatwave-2022.synopticAssessment: Post-event verification proved that the 5 km conditional diffusion model resolved the urban heat-island amplification over Delhi NCR 24 hours before peak temperature, whereas standard 12 km NWP under-resolved the ridge's local intensification.

mumbai-2021.name: Mumbai Convective Deluge
mumbai-2021.synopticAssessment: Post-event verification proved that the 5 km conditional diffusion model accurately localized the mesoscale convective cell over Santacruz 6 hours before peak inundation, whereas standard 12 km NWP smoothed the cell across the wider Mumbai coastline.

biparjoy-2023.name: Cyclone Biparjoy
biparjoy-2023.synopticAssessment: Post-event verification proved that the 5 km conditional diffusion model tracked the storm's unusually long Arabian Sea stalling phase 14 hours before landfall, whereas standard 12 km NWP underpredicted the eventual Kutch coast recurvature.
